t: Repair the broken Harvester near the Gates base

Even though there are plenty of spare parts for new mechanoids in our warehouses, we must cut corners wherever we can. Let's fix what was broken.

Like, for instance, our harvester. A universal resource collector and a moving processing plant that turns wood into ambrosia.

Try and fix it. You should find plenty of spare parts around the base.
Every second that our harvesters stand idly is a lost profit. Hurry.
Wonderful! We brought an old harvester back in line and saved our resources. We can even pay bonuses to the staff.

Now that we've solved the most pressing issues, it's time to take care of Penelope.

My old friends Herbert de Vevre and Elena Zimina hang out there. They interrupted their vacations on my request. Yes, I know they're Zayan's spies. And City Council's. And Detective Bureau's. So what? They're outstanding researchers. It's all that matters.

The problem is that we stopped getting updates from Penelope a week ago. There's no way to send a messenger. You can't get to Penelope on foot through the dense forest, full of predators.

Perhaps, their transmitter is broken, but we must be prepared for the worst. The defense perimeter is equipped worse than the Gates base.

I suggest we go together. Let's take Skulnar and Eurial. They're the smartest of your guys.

We're going by an experimental all-terrain forest-hacking anti-predator armored harvester. The navigation bot will lead us. Keep following it, don't stop.
The harvester's explosion was unfortunate. Thank Tensess, it's very hard to die here. Even severe wounds heal in no time. Let's see what we have on the other base.

So many victims, so much blood spilled... Do you want to destroy the Great Tree? The source of this world's life force that allows the Ambrosia to flow through its veins?

I'm tired of watching you kill my Children... What do you even want?

Ambrosia? I can give it to you, just stop destroying my world!

Protection from Nihaz? Is that what my lost daughter wants? I will help her.

Just stop. Tell her... this sorceress who has a shard of Sarn in her...
It's time to hit the road... If you are ready, we can do it right now.

Well, that suits me just fine.

Actually, it's what we initially wanted.

I just need to be sure that she won't try to impose her rules on anyone when she comes into our world. Otherwise, I'm not ready to give up technology at the behest of some goddess, even if she wants the best for everyone.

"Has a shard of Sarn in her" - what is she trying to say? What?!
h: Yes, if you stop this war

t: Return to Sarnaut and find out what happens next

Sarnaut. The world that Sarn created. And populated with different races. Indeed, I'd be interested to see what he created.

And even though Nihaz has corrupted my friend's creation, I still want to see it.

While I'm away, Rhubarb will look after my Children. Let's go.

Well, you're probably wondering what happened.

This was all part of my plan, so I'll tell you what happened.

It was a long road that took a lot of time. And, as you already understand, without you and Klavdia I wouldn't have succeeded.

Yes, my friend - I was behind every event since the moment the mad Kyros decided that the immortality I bestowed on you was unnecessary.

I hope you've learned to appreciate Daddy's gifts since then?

Fine, I see you're dying to know what's going on. Let's dot the i's.

What, you didn't expect that?

Hmm…
And yes, if you are thinking of destroying my prison again or killing the prisoner... I'm afraid nothing will come of it this time.
Talk to Hirkalla and find out what happens next

I won't leave Sarnaut unattended. It would be too dangerous to give all power to born destroyers.

My eldest daughter will look after things. Yes, Hirkalla will make sure that you don't break anything around here. Of course, my system of Citadels and Seals will continue to work. It never stopped working, and your attempts to break it were initially futile due to the fact that everything was repeatedly duplicated and supplemented with backup and contingency plans. I never bet on just one card, you see.

As for Klavdia, she will still play her part, you can be sure of that.

Well, it's time to say goodbye. Fight your destiny, Hero of Sarnaut.
Well, well, well. What do we have here?

I see my plans inspired you.

Great things await us! It will be lots of fun!!

Where do I start?

Well, first tell Yasker the news - let him rejoice. If he is afraid of Cosmos, reassure him - our control of the Citadels won't let the Observatory change the past and destroy the Empire.

As for the rest, I expect obedience and cooperation from him. If he works with me, he will be rewarded. Otherwise I will show him the true meaning of the words "torments of hell".

See you soon, hero!

What?!

I have no words.

You... you... what have you done? You surrendered our world to the Goddess of Darkness?

This is outrageous! I trusted you, but you and Klavdia... you ruined everything! How could you be so reckless?

Get out! Get out of my sight! I don't want to see you again! And you... you're not a hero anymore, and everyone will know what you did!

And I… need to think.

What a day! Strange signs everywhere, and even stranger assignments.

You're , right? I'm here to deliver a message.

In short, a certain Alice is waiting for you at the Astral Academy... She asked you to come.

I hope I took some of the weight off your mind.

At least you and I are in the same boat now.

I'm not saying goodbye, because you can always find me...

Where do I start?

Well, first tell Aidenus the news - let him rejoice. If he is afraid of Cosmos, reassure him - our control of the Citadels won't let the Observatory change the past and destroy the League.

As for the rest, I expect obedience and cooperation from him. If he works with me, he will be rewarded. Otherwise I will show him the true meaning of the words "torments of hell".

See you soon, hero!

What?!

I have no words.

You... you... what have you done? You surrendered our world to the Goddess of Darkness?

This is outrageous! I trusted you, but you and Klavdia... you ruined everything! How could you be so reckless?

Get out! Get out of my sight! I don't want to see you again! And you... you're not a hero anymore, and everyone will know what you did!

And I… need to think.

What a day! Strange signs everywhere, and even stranger assignments.

You're , right? I'm here to deliver a message.

In short, a certain Alice is waiting for you at the Astral Academy... She asked you to come.

I hope I took some of the weight off your mind.

At least you and I are in the same boat now.

I'm not saying goodbye, because you can always find me...
Eliminate the Fire Throwers of the Expedition

All this time we have successfully resisted the Expedition's attempts to seize our Ambrosia, and it looks like their patience has come to an end.

One of your friends, a Priden named Murk, has passed on a message. He reports that the leader of your people, Felix, has ordered an all-out attack using all available forces.

They have adopted a new tactic, trying to cause panic among the animals so they flee in our direction and throw our forces into disorder. To do this, they use new troops armed with strange weapons that spout fire!

We need to stop them. Let's kill those fire starters!
Fire is one of the most destructive forces. We need to tame it before it devours the entire valley.
We managed to prevent the worst. However, the main enemy forces are approaching.
Fight Felix with Skulnar the Fierce

Eh, when I came to this world, I didn't think I'd have to fight. But it looks like we have no other options. Too bad our guys from the Landfill aren't here. They love a good fight, heh.

Wait, you're not the only one I'm going to have a chat with. I'll try and use this psionic stuff to reach out to our people. I hope everyone hears my speech.

In short, this Expedition is trying to prove they are calling the shots here and that no one will stop them. But we have something to say about that!

We contacted members of other tribes of Eden, and they joined us! Now we'll show the Expedition they have no power here and that this land doesn't belong to them!

You and I have a special task - Felix is somewhere among the troops. Their Commander in Chief. If he's gone, the Expedition troops will be in turmoil.

Well, shall we deal with the Xadaganian?
Felix is somewhere out there! We need to defeat him!

Skulnar and Felix have left the battle!

But this is not the end. Catherina is on her way here with some monstrous device that can destroy everything around!

It's something monstrous.

They... used the power of the Ambrosia to make their weapons more powerful. If it works, then... the entire Valley will be destroyed.

We can't let this happen! Our warriors are wounded, but we must fight as one!

Everyone, we need to destroy this bomb before it reaches the Great Tree!
We have only one chance! Disable this device!

ENOUGH!

This is going too far. Stop this madness!
Clear a path using the flamethrower to fight the beasts

We're wasting time!

Everyone here is fighting for survival. Hordes of locals are preparing to attack.

The number of enemy combatants rose from a few hundred to thousands in recent weeks.

And many of them are still on the way, soon there will be even more of them! At this point, they will breach the perimeter.

But that won't happen. The only way to safety is a preemptive strike.

We will fight terror with terror! Our enemies naively believe that the thorns of the Valley are protecting their Great Tree.

When it's destroyed, they will remember this lesson even thousands of years down the line!

I've tasked the flamethrower troops with clearing the way for our mana bomb. I command you to go with them and provide support.
We must clear a path for the mana bomb to achieve our goal!
Let the earth and the skies burn! Let the astral blaze! I will achieve my goal or I will raze everything to the ground!
Fight Skulnar the Fierce with Felix

Yes, some of our allies disappointed me...

Those who came with you to Eden. Skulnar the Fierce. Eurial. And even Murk. Yes, him too.

They chose to go over to the Children's side. And thus they betrayed Sarnaut!

However, I never trusted the orc. It's all about Yasker. Once he was worthy of leading the Empire, but over time he softened, became weak. He should have nipped this orc rebellion in the bud, but he still hesitates...

The Empire is an idea! We shouldn't doubt what we're doing. When we get enough Ambrosia, Catherina and I will return to Sarnaut and establish a completely different order there. The Empire and the League have become too weak. They will be transformed into a new state, and we will lead it!

Let's move onward - the future lies there, right behind this one orc who is destined to die at the hands of an Imperial warrior! And I will fix the mistake made by the Observatory!
It will be all over when I give the order.

Felix is unconscious, and so is Skulnar...

But the battle must be finished! We have no other choice!

You need to bring the mana bomb to the right spot. After that I will teleport us out of here with a spell!

We have a unique weapon - a mana bomb enhanced by the Ambrosia.

Nobody knows the real power of this device.

Presumably, it's capable of turning this whole Valley into a big crater. It will stop this war.

Our troops have suffered heavy losses, and I understand that it won't be easy, but we're almost there. Bring this bomb to the agreed point, and it will be over.
It's time to finish what we started!

ENOUGH!

This is going too far. Stop this madness!
Your destructive tendencies scare me. Is this the foundation Sarn laid when he created you?

Dear child, if I imposed my vision on all the worlds, would we have the diversity Verbena must have told you about? When mortals choose their path, I do not interfere...

I have no power to destroy what is created. I am a creator, not a destroyer.

Your immortality primarily harms you. I could heal you... but you don't want that. So be it.
Find the ghosts and ask what they want
I sense something unusual in our city. A large number of paranormal entities have appeared. I wanted to call ghost hunters first, but maybe we can deal with it ourselves? Ask them what they want.
Find all the ghosts and find out what they want.
They must have been resurrected by Hirkalla, I guess? Well, let's hope they will soon leave Nezebgrad and go straight to Jigran!
Find the ghosts and ask what they want
Miracles are happening in the city! These strange ghosts have appeared... Find out what they need - perhaps trouble is brewing!
You need to find all the ghosts!
I see! They are Hirkalla's creations... I hope they leave Novograd soon and go straight to Jigran!
Raise an army that can defeat the Expedition

So you're on our side. Now I see it, and I understand that you decided to become one of us.

I know that it was not easy for you to leave your tribesmen. But the Expedition does not understand what they are doing. They think harvesting the Ambrosia will give them divine powers against Nihaz.

But the Ambrosia is the force of life itself. It can't destroy, it can only create. So they are going to fail.

Unfortunately, it is impossible to explain this simple truth to them. There is only one thing left - to drive them out of Eden, once and for all.

And while the forces of my tribe can hold off their onslaught, destroying their base is a much more difficult task. Fortunately, we are not alone on Eden - there are other tribes here.

Your task is to enlist their support.
How is the training of our troops going?

You bring good news!

Our scouts report that the Expedition is preparing to set out...

The story of Eden is nearing its end.

The final battle is close, and who wins it depends on you.

Of course, you believe siding with the Children will help you achieve the goal that Klavdia set for you.

My friend, I'm glad to see you!

I was just thinking of sending for you. I need to tell you something important.
Raise an army that can defeat the Expedition

How is the training of our troops going?

You bring good news!

Our scouts report that the Expedition is preparing to set out...

We organize trainings. The warriors of your tribe will train the warriors of our tribes.

Alas, if they come to us, your lands will be left without defenders. If you can replace them for a while, then we can finish this training sooner.

To do this, complete the tasks given to you by Camelia, Sumac, and Elm.

Traitors - "the Children's supporters" - do not care about other people's lives or their own. In this regard, I order you to take emergency precautions. The enemy can come alone or with an army. They may come in the form of our soldiers. We must stop them. You can't let the enemy infiltrate the base. Which is why I order you to remember three simple rules:

First. Do not trust the uniform or the title if you don't know the person.

Second. Anyone who goes inside the perimeter must be destroyed.

Third. Shoot first, ask questions later. It's better to lose a few of our men through a misunderstanding than through carelessness.

Any change to these rules must come from me personally.

Aside from that, I have a special task for you...

What's taking so long?

We have a critical situation here - the threat is mounting. We must remember one thing: our people are counting on us. And we can't let them down. I'll say one more thing. When this is over, you're all getting promotions and government awards.

The story of Eden is nearing its end.

The final battle is close, and who wins it depends on you.

And while you are not doing what Klavdia wants you to do, you still expect the Expedition to help defeat Nihaz.

Oh, my friend! You're just in time.

I was just thinking of sending for you. I need to tell you something important.

Traitors - "the Children's supporters" - do not care about other people's lives or their own. In this regard, I order you to take emergency precautions. The enemy can come alone or with an army. They may come in the form of our soldiers. We must stop them. You can't let the enemy infiltrate the base. Which is why I order you to remember three simple rules:

Second. Anyone who goes inside the perimeter must be destroyed.

Third. Shoot first, ask questions later. It's better to lose a few of our men through a misunderstanding than through carelessness.

Aside from that, I have a special task for you...

What's taking so long?

We have a critical situation here - the threat is mounting. We must remember one thing: our people are counting on us. And we can't let them down. I'll say one more thing. When this is over, you're all getting promotions and government awards.

We need one of those codes that are changed daily to activate the Gates... One that would get us onto the Star Trail.

Of course, no one will give it to you, but it looks like our crafty and cunning Priden managed to get the password. I'd ask him myself, but it would be too suspicious. But no one would suspect you.
h: What can I do to help?

t: I always felt like our adventures would eventually take us to a place we wouldn't be able to get out of.

What will be the cost of this victory? If we do this, are we any better than Nihaz? He also destroys worlds for the purposes we don't even understand...

Well, if that's your decision, then so be it. But I want no part of this. I have a proposition - you will let us leave Eden, and I will give you the component. Everything that happens after that will be on your conscience.

Yes, I know Felix implemented high-security protocols, but Elena seems to have an idea. Speak with her.
Here. And be far away when it does its thing. And now goodbye. Soon Elena and I will leave Eden.
Yes, I did not expect this when I agreed to visit this world.

The component was taken by this elf, Herbert. Maybe he needed it for something, or maybe he is some kind of saboteur, yeah. Ask him to return it.

Without this part, no big boom is gonna happen.
Find Hazmat Suits for the Expedition members and fix the mana flow.

We fought off the first attack. Good. But it's not our only problem. We got a problem with the mana flow. The worst part is that the way to the mana station is guarded by Draconids. You're the local hero, right? So you should be able to get to the mana station and restore power flow.

But first let's talk about the situation.
Have you found the suits? Is the power back on? No? Well, why don't you take care of it, Hero of Sarnaut?

I didn't expect to see him here... although I should have known.

Alright, what are we going to do? Try to drive him out? The whole place is going to be destroyed if we start a fight.

Looks like we don't have any other choice. I could deal with the Draconids but I'm not so sure about the Great Mage... and the demons and Wormfaces attacking from behind. No, that's too much.

Let's discuss conditions. I wonder what he wants from us. He can't have Skulnar and the Gates but if he wants to tag along to leave Sarnaut... whatever. He can join.
No time to talk. The enemies are approaching, and the Gates are still out of order. Chop-chop!

Farewell!

I hope you can complete everything we talked about. Remember, my mother's patronage is Sarnaut's only chance for salvation.

As I said, all I need is to enter the Gates. You let me and Sturegga pass, we can keep you company until we reach your destination, and then we'll say our goodbyes. You can keep Skulnar.

Besides, our Draconids will help you defend the Gates from other races, trying to break out of Sarnaut.
h: She wants to hear about your terms.

t:
The Gates are working. And that's great! All that's left to do is exit them. It might be the hardest part. The previous Expedition lost more than half its members on the way between the worlds.

Don't worry about the hazmat suit. It's equipped automatically when you enter the Interverse. We implemented after the last time. Not everyone was smart enough to equip it manually, you know...

Anyway, good luck!
Welcome to Eden. The new world, different from Sarnaut.
Protect the Great Mage from architects.

Phew. Everyone's here. We haven't lost a soul.

We need to make a few more leaps to reach the destination. You can never guess where a leap might take you, hah.

The ancient elf will cover us with a shield. We need to survive till he casts a new spell. As you see, we aren't alone here. Those fartitects were split into shards when the core was destroyed. Now they're at war with one another. That's what Catherina said. They're too busy fussing with one another but they're gonna notice us soon.
I thought we were done with. Hah. There were so many of them. The first leap is over, but we still have many to make.
Get to the next portal, while avoiding the gaze of the creature of Darkness.

Where are we?

Elleken's spell scattered us over different paths of the Trail, hah. But that's fine. There's a portal nearby. We will find the rest of the group in not time. I've got a trick up my sleeve to run the portal.

There's just one thing... see that exploded sphere over there? Something ancient lives in it. It's not gonna be happy to see us.

It's got an exceptional nose for magic. It's going to see me if I budge. Get ready. We'll have to run for our dear lives as fast as we only can!
Help Skulnar solve the riddle before entering the portal.

Well, here we are. We need to go our separate ways now. You've almost reached your destination. I will be on my way, and so will Sturegga. Where? You're not supposed to know this.

We might meet again.

You will make more discoveries that will make you look at our story at a different angle.

Eurial is staying with you. She needs to gain some experience. All that's left to do is help Skulnar solve some kind of a riddle. Farewell.
Greetings in Eden! Get down to business.

Uh, you see, we wrote it in a way so only a Sarnaut dweller would understand. It mentions only the latest events, hah. The problem is that I wasn't an eye-witness, so I can't judge. I completely missed the Gods versus Fartitects fight. Here's what it says:

We learned the truth about the Light,

That Demons aren't Sarnaut's blight.

The God of Darkness got a new foe:

Threat under mountains and snow.

Walked along Nezeb's sandy path.

You're still here with us? You can reveal it, it's no high-school math.
h: Alright, what does this stone say...

t: I'm glad you answered my call...
Deal with the enemy troops and find Eladia.

Greetings, comrade!

It's been several months since you found the Chronophone. We haven't lost time!

The Expedition, headed by Catherina and Felix, my colleague from Yakhch, has departed for another world. They successfully passed the Gates, evaded all dangers, and landed on Eladia's exact coordinates.

Sadly, there have been no news ever since.

Moreover, the Gates themselves are now under threat. There was a massive attack on our allod! Armies from all Sarnaut gathered here. While our brave fleet is fighting dragons and demons in Astral, there's another fight with enemy troops at the Gates. Wormfaces crawled out of their caves, too.

They want to get through the Gates and leave Sarnaut. We can't afford losing control over this object! We invested so much effort in it. Eladia needs your help as soon as possible. I'll teleport you to the Gates construction site. You will need to find her there.

Try to get rid of some of the enemies along the way. It'll make your life a little easier.
No time for talking! We're under attack!
Who could have thought that our humble little Gates will hit Sarnaut's jackpot this year?
Find examples of divine powers in action.

We continue our lessons.

Light. Darkness. Order. Chaos. These are the divine powers. They rule the world, guide the intelligent beings, set them on the right paths.

We can't get rid of Darkness because we need it. Darkness is part of the natural cycle of life.

I would like you to realize this simple truth. The divine powers don't belong to Sarn, or Nihaz, or someone else, equally powerful. They show everywhere. Go and find examples of divine powers in the world.

See, the divine powers are everywhere. If there were no Darkness, there wouldn't be hideout for animals, there wouldn't be nights for resting. Without Chaos, the world would have never seen change. Everything is important. Everything matters.
Find examples of divine powers in action in the Howling Forest

I want you to repeat my lesson.

Light, Darkness, Order, Chaos. These are the divine powers. They rule the world, guide intelligent beings, set them on the right path.

We can't get rid of Darkness because we need it. Darkness is part of the natural cycle of life.

I would like you to realize this simple truth. Divine powers don't belong to Sarn, or Nihaz, or any other powerful being. They manifest themselves everywhere. Go and find examples of divine powers in the world.

Go and learn this lesson again!
You need to know how the divine forces manifest themselves in our worlds...
You have learned your lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
Tune the balance of life in this part of the forest.

From the previous lessons you know that everything is connected. Herbs and vegetables are food for herbivores, herbivores are food for predators, who return to the soil after death and become food for herbs and vegetables.

The circle can't be broken. Death isn't a problem. The tipped balance creates more problems than anything else. Everything must be strictly measured. If my creations eat all herbs and veggies, they will die. If there are too many predators, they will eat all herbivores, and they're also going to die.

Life is a great power. Death is the reverse of life. Believe me, life will always find a way to correct mistakes. But if we want our gardens to be the most beautiful place ever, we need someone to tune the balance.

My Children are the keepers of balance in Eden. You must learn the lesson that is why I want you to do their job.
Some think that predators are evil for creatures like Sunbunnies. But as you understand now, they aren't. Some have to die but others live and strive.
Create a balance between the living creatures in the Howling Forest and Grassy Woodland

I want you to repeat my lesson.

Herbivores feed on plants and become food for predators who return to the soil after death and nourish plants.

The circle can't be broken. Death is not a problem. Disturbed balance creates more problems than anything else. Everything must be in moderation. If my creations eat all plants, they will die. If there are too many predators, they will eat all the herbivores, and they're also going to die.

Life is a great power. Death is the reverse side of life. Believe me, life will find a way and correct all mistakes, but if we want our gardens to flourish, we need someone to maintain the balance.

My Children are the keepers of balance in Eden. You must learn this lesson, and that's why I want you to do their job.

Go and learn this lesson again!
You need to understand the balance of all living things...
You have learned your lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
Find the thing that worried All-Mother.

Are you deceiving me, Child of Sarn?

While you're learning my lessons, there's something strange going on in the Forest. I hear my plants screaming in pain, hear my animals calling upon me in agony.

Go to the distant forest. Find out what's happening.
We have no time to waste!
The harvester has suffered a fit of rage. It's damaged beyond repair.
This is one of the Expedition's harvesters. Have they gone this far?

What is the harvester doing so deep in the forest? A battle happened here. I need to track it down and see what happened.

I wonder who sent them here and why...

Haven't I warned you against ruining our Forest, aliens?

All-Mother trusted you, but you just went on with your nasty deeds? You're going to die. We're going to destroy all your disgusting metal monsters and wipe out your homes, build without permission on the land of Eden!
Destroy the harvester and its convoy.

These... machine of yours have gone mad.

Not only do they destroy our animals and plants, they attack your own people!

Eliminate the plague before I do it. And don't get me started, otherwise I'll storm through your iron harvesters all the way to the Gates, and I'll stop only to kick your out of my world!
Destroy everyone who is corrupting our forest!

Maybe... just maybe... Maybe I can trust you.

Tell the fools at your base that we will never tolerate another invasion of iron machines.
Destroy the Harvester and its convoy in the Dusk Grove

The Children say that your iron Harvesters are once again chopping down my forest and everything in it. Alas, if the Expedition does not understand that they should stay away from the forest, they will have to learn the hard way.

Rid us of these poor imitations of the living.
Eliminate everything that's defiling our forest!
This semblance of life will never replace real life. To better understand my lesson, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
Find the missing Expedition members and Elena Zimina.

Greetings!

Under less tragic circumstances, I'd be jumping with joy seeing you. But the way things are going, I must ask for your help.  Don't laugh but Elena is missing again. Well, it isn't funny anyway... The most part of our group has gone missing along with her.

Our adventure in the Forest is quite a story! Although I'm not sure that I could ever put the horrors we survived into words.

All that matter is that the... wooden lady agreed to spare our lives for now. I suppose, most of my companions fell into different traps here, in the forest. I would be grateful if you could find them all and bring them here. Once we gather together, we'll negotiate our freedom.
We have no time to waste!
It was wrong to call the children "hippies." Herbert told me that they could kill us all if it weren't for you. Well... thanks!
You're here! How fortunate. First, the aborigines attacked, then the machines went mad, so I just ran... and ran, and ran. And then I found myself here. I'm stuck. Will you help me free?
I'm waiting for the right moment. Don't worry, I'll get the others. I'd rather land in woodfaces' prison than in the middle of the rise of the machines.
Uh, that's much better. Thanks. I'll find my own way from here when it gets quiet.

I'm still thinking that we must leave this place. I'm worried.

If Willow agrees to set us free, I won't mind! But she said that the local animals are angry with us.

Perhaps you could help us out again? Herbert and I on our own could get out of any situation. But we'll be bringing our research fellows. They're not soldiers, they don't know the first thing about dangers.

Can you take us to the campsite?
Where's your company? Ran away? Come over, let's talk.

Hah! What a nice little encore! A tragic encounter in the Forest! How dramatic!

So, what do you have to say? Nothing? I thought so.

Let's start then. We need to finish this play.
What's up? Who got into a fight with you? Can I even leave you alone for five minutes?
Listen to Catherina and return to All-Mother.
Calm down, breathe... you can report later. I also have news for you. Good or bad, it's up to you to decide.

Hirkalla...

She has never been obedient. Both sisters had incredible potential... if only Nihaz didn't lead them astray.

And now look at her. Poor Children that trusted her... they can't accept their own fate. I'm afraid, you're too weak to fight her yet. You have a lot to learn.

I'll summon you later, when it's the right time for the final lesson.
Learn a lesson about life and death

Are you ready for the next lesson?

So, you already know about the existence of two circles of forces present in all things. The forces of nature and the forces of the gods. They manifest themselves everywhere, but there is a third circle - the most important one. The circle of forces of the demiurges, those who create worlds.

Everything is subject to our laws, and these laws come from the forces the demiurges represent: Life and Death, Creation and Destruction. One is impossible without the other.

To you mortals, Death seems evil, but you must understand that it is one with Life. One is impossible without the other.

You have to learn this simple truth.
Hurry, time is of the essence.

Destruction leads to balance, because its essence is time. Insurmountable and unstoppable. Rocks disintegrate into dust, oceans dry up, luminaries die. Time dominates everything...

And only Creation can oppose it. Build a city out of sand. Grow a garden in the wasteland. Kindle a warm fire.
Learn a lesson about life and death to the north of Illuian's lair

I want you to repeat my lesson.

 So, you already know about the existence of two circles of forces present in all things. The forces of nature and the forces of the gods. They manifest themselves everywhere, but there is a third circle - the most important one. The circle of forces of the demiurges, those who create worlds.

Everything is subject to our laws, and these laws come from the forces the demiurges represent: Life and Death, Creation and Destruction. One is impossible without the other.

To you mortals, Death seems evil, but you must understand that it is one with Life. One is impossible without the other.

Go and learn this lesson again!
You need to understand the nature of demiurges' powers and how they manifest themselves.
You have learned your lesson. To understand the true meaning of my words, you need to repeat the experience. Come back here tomorrow.
Defeat the dragon Illuian and... die.

One of the last and most important lessons.

Why do you think I create nations and uplift heroes in them?

In the beginning, people live in primitive savagery and fear. Around them are vast, unexplored lands inhabited by monsters.

But then a hero comes, and everything changes. They perform feats in the name of us, gods; they expand the spaces available to their people, they bring knowledge and skills. Sooner or later, every hero realizes that they are mortal. And they begin to seek immortality.

But only gods are immortal, not people. The most important moment for any hero like you is to understand that they are mortal. It is time for you to understand this, too.

If you wish to learn my lesson, then go into the woods. An ancient monster dwells there who has existed for as long as I have... Illuian.

Fight him... and die.

Not everyone is destined to die knowing they won't be resurrected.

But it's not your time yet.
Defeat the dragon Illuian in his lair

Sometimes my Children don't listen to me...

Well, such is the fate of every mother, but admonition is also necessary.

Illuian, the dragon you know, sometimes rebels against fate - to be a living witness to the struggle of heroes against monsters. Then I need to calm him down before he hurts my Children.

Alas, usually a meeting with him is fatal for heroes, but we know that the moment of your final death has not yet come. So go to him and interrupt his existence for a while - until he is reborn again.
Illuian continues to struggle, but he has lost this battle.
An old friend and foe, he has witnessed so many events... Eternity is his punishment.
Defeat the dragon Illuian in his lair

I've been told that the Children have a real dragon here! We could do without one. Treebor and Cypress pose enough problems as it is.

Luckily, intelligence says that the dragon is quite weak...until he recovers his strength, there is a chance to defeat him.

There are two "buts": firstly, the power of Eden is such that even a dragon torn to pieces will be reborn after some time. It can only die of old age - but do you know of any dragon that died of old age?!!

Secondly, its poison is extremely venomous. If it gets into your blood, death is inevitable. So be careful and don't let him poison you. If that happens...

Well, we will remember you as a hero.
I can't plan my next move while I'm thinking of the dragon right next to our base!
The dragon is defeated? And you managed to survive? Incredible. This once again proves that you can be trusted to complete the most risky and dangerous tasks!

Now I need to know if you really learned my lessons.

I will ask and you will answer.

Let's meet in my Sanctuary, before my other Children.
Well, I see that you have learned my lessons. You are truly free from Nihaz's Darkness. Now we need to decide what to do about this Expedition which is nowhere near as reasonable as you...
Find Rhubarb and explore the area

You have proven that my lessons have indeed sunk in.

Now it's time to dispel the darkness that settled in our forests. The apostates who serve darkness rejected their fate and turned against me and my Children. They, too, need to be taught a harsh lesson.

You will be my avenging hand: go to Rhubarb and find out what needs to be done to put an end to this pathetic rebellion once and for all.
Ashes to ashes, rot to rot.

What? Do you think we care about your Expedition? Its fate will be the same as that of everyone on this land.

The same goes for this Old Tribe that refuses to accept its fate!
Collect the stolen Ambrosia and weapons off the bodies on the battlefield near the Withered Grove

The expedition continues to harm us. My Children are very upset that ambrosia continues to be stolen. Both the Expedition and the Old Tribe are responsible for this.

The scouts reported that a battle took place on the edge of the Withered Grove where aliens from another world fought these madmen led by Hirkalla.

The children arrived as the battle was drawing to a close. They also suffered losses.

We need to recover the stolen Ambrosia and the lost weapons which can still serve my Children in future battles.
Eden has been a peaceful world for many centuries, but behold - the war has come here again.
Excellent. I'm sure this weapon will still serve my Children, and the Ambrosia will be returned to the cycle.
Collect the carcass samples and notes off the bodies on the battlefield near the Withered Grove

Alas, we suffer irretrievable losses in this world! And who is dying? Not warriors, no. Scientists!

Recently, one of our science teams was returning from a mission when they ran into these savages! They didn't take prisoners and just slaughtered everyone!

We can't bring back the fallen. There is no Purgatory in this world, so death here is final. But they had samples and notes with them that could help us in our research.

Please go to the edge of the Withered Grove, find their bodies, and collect records and notes.
If we manage to recover the notes, then the sacrifice of our friends was not in vain!
Thank you. Thank you so much! I think this world will bring us more losses, but we are still going to conquer it!
Eliminate the members of the Old Tribe

Once the Old Tribe were just like us. But the life of their Tree came to an end, and their tribe began to wither and die. Instead of accepting their fate, they rebelled and turned against the All-Mother.

Now they constantly attack our lands and steal our Ambrosia, intending to live forever. That's not going to happen!

Show them that Darkness has no place in Eden. The goddess they swore allegiance to has no power here! Kill them, stop this senseless rebellion against nature.

Reed will go with you.
Final and inglorious death. I hope their Sparks get lost in the deepest caverns of Eresh, beyond the gates of Ganzir.
Eliminate the members of the Old Tribe in the Withered Grove

Once the Old Tribe was just like the rest of my Children. But the life of their Tree came to an end, and their tribe began to wither and die. Instead of humbly accepting their fate, they rebelled and turned against me.

Now they constantly attack the lands of my Children and steal their Ambrosia. They want to live forever. This can't happen.

Show them that Darkness has no place in Eden. The goddess they swore allegiance to has no power here! Kill them, stop this senseless rebellion against nature.
The time of the Old Tribe has passed. That's the law.
Well, this rebellion never stood a chance, they followed Hirkalla's illusion like many other people before them.
Eliminate the members of the Old Tribe in the Withered Grove

I hear the Old Tribe was once just like the rest of the Children. But the life of their Tree came to an end, and their tribe began to wither and die. Instead of accepting their fate, they rebelled and turned against the All-Mother.

Perhaps they could become our allies, but, alas, we couldn't get them to negotiate with us. The Old Tribe attacks our Harvesters just like any other tribe of the Children.

And our scouts have to fight them if they run into one...

Which means we have no other choice - we will exterminate them just like any other enemy in this world!

The Old Tribe lives mostly in the Withered Grove. Pay them a visit to undermine their military strength!
No one can guarantee that the Old Tribe will not attack our base, too!
Well, the fewer enemies we have to deal with, the better. It doesn't matter which side they are on.
Kill the Old Tribe and burn the corpses

Truly, there is nothing more disgusting than violation of divine laws. This darkness that has settled in that forest is able to return Sparks to dead bodies. Blasphemy!

However, this sorceress of yours, Eurial, suggested something that will interrupt their unholy existence: fire!

Burn their bodies, and then the Darkness will not be able to bring them back to life.

You also need to kill their leaders who were the first to turn to the Darkness. By breaking their will to resist, we will finally put an end to this rebellion.
It looks like this rebellion has come to an end. The strength of the Old Tribe is broken. Reed will stay with me, you will proceed alone.
Kill the members of the Old Tribe and burn the corpses in the Withered Grove

The darkness that has settled in the Withered Grove can return Sparks to dead bodies.

However, this sorceress of yours, Eurial, suggested something that will cut their unholy existence short: fire!

Burn their bodies, and then the Darkness will not be able to revive them - even if Hirkalla finds her way back to Eden.

You see, the Old Tribe is already dead, so we'll just return them to their true state. There's no other way.
Darkness is best fought by light, and fire creates light.
It looks like the rebellion of the Old Tribe will be over soon. The Old Tribe is still strong, but its numbers are rapidly declining. Victory is only a matter of time now.
Kill the members of the Old Tribe and burn the corpses in the Withered Grove

I've been told that this goddess is Hirkalla, a powerful necromancer who has the ability to return Sparks to dead bodies. Thanks to this, she keeps bringing the members of the Old Tribe back to "life".

However, Eurial suggested something that will cut their unholy existence short: fire!

Burn their bodies, and then the Darkness will not be able to bring them back to life.

Alas, the Old Tribe is also at war with us, so we'll have to deal with them, too. And we could definitely do without the undead.
If the Old Tribe burns so well, will the other inhabitants of this world also burn?
Great, we managed to eliminate this threat before we had to fight on two fronts. Hirkalla is dangerous, and I hope we'll never see her again.

Ohh... there are... too many of them...

The darkness is strong. Many of us have been injured. Please help us... I have some Ambrosia - put it in your flask and try to heal our wounded with it.

The Ambrosia is the power of life itself. It will overcome the damage that the darkness has done and heal them.

Did my sister send you? Thanks!

The Darkness is over there... in the center of the grove! Beware!

There's true evil here. Even I'm... scared.

Waterlily is missing. This daredevil loves to rush headfirst into danger, so she might be in trouble. If the prophecies about you are true, then you will defeat the Darkness.

So... don't waste time. Save Waterlily and rid our forest of evil.
Alright, that's enough games. The ritual is disrupted, and I'm too lazy to start it again. Consider this victory yours. Let's talk!

Good, evil... How naive...

You don't have a feeling that my mother is not telling you everything? That she is not quite the kind goddess you were hoping to find here?

Do you want to know what's really going on here in Eden?
So are we going to fight or just talk?

In any case, my job here is done.

Bye, losers!
Return to Rhubarb and learn the news

Oh, damn...

I will stay here to say goodbye to those who died. And with the Children, and those who were called the Old Tribe. We all deserve to be mourned.

The old tribe was wrong, but that doesn't make it any easier for me.

You need to go back to Rhubarb and tell him what that happened here...

So you were asked to deliver an ultimatum? The Children want war? They will have it!

Do you have something to say? I have something to say to you, too...
Traitor! You are all traitors! How treacherous! How deceitful!

How foul...

We agreed that the harvesting of Ambrosia would be stopped! But your mechanoids started harvesting it in the Ambrosia Valley, a sacred place at the very roots of the Great Tree...

We are not going to tolerate this kind of insolence any longer. Our warriors are going into battle to throw you out of this world!

Your tribesmen cannot be trusted!

We agreed that the harvesting of Ambrosia would be stopped! But your mechanoids started harvesting it in the Ambrosia Valley, the sacred place at the very roots of the Great Tree...

We are not going to tolerate this kind of insolence any longer. Our warriors are going into battle to throw you out of this world!
h: You are crazy! I'm on your side!

t:
Foul hypocrite! All this time, you and the others have been working for the Expedition!

We agreed that the harvesting of Ambrosia would be stopped! But your mechanoids started harvesting it in the Ambrosia Valley, the sacred place at the very roots of the Great Tree...

We are not going to tolerate this kind of insolence any longer. Our warriors are going into battle to throw you out of this world!
h: What gives you the right to say that?

t:
You are out of touch with reality.

You run along the branches, talk to deer, pet your grass hares. But we came into this world for a completely different purpose!
I see doubt in your eyes. But now we need those who will stand by our side. It remains to see whether you are with us or not.
Yes? Or maybe you got them to agree to help us in our fight against Nihaz? Is this All-Mother ready to join us?

That's what I'm talking about...

These gods are useless. They are nothing but trouble.

I'm tired of this. We'll solve our problems ourselves. If we can get enough Ambrosia, then we'll be as powerful as the gods.

From now on, anyone who stands in our way will be crushed. If the Children try to stop us, we will burn everything to the ground!

Now report back to Catherina about everything you've learned. I'm preparing a general offensive to protect our Harvesters.
h: Well... it's not going as well as we hoped.

t: Meet with the All-Mother in her sanctuary in Eden to continue the storyline.

The letter, written by Queen Catherina, reads as follows:

"Greetings. Our situation in Eden continues to deteriorate.

It is necessary to continue diplomatic efforts to arrange negotiations with the All-Mother. Additionally, our scouts report a large concentration of warriors of the so-called "Old Tribe". They might be a threat both to us and the Children.

Come to Eden as soon as possible. Complete your negotiations with the All-Mother."

You need to go to Eden and complete the training with the All-Mother.
I knew you would come to me. It's time to continue our lessons.
Listen to All-Mother and Catherina and choose a side to support.

You have to think hard now.

You are a child of Sarn from an unusual world. I understand that it isn't so easy to reject your legacy.

Perhaps, you will find my reasoning more convincing. You might start sharing my children's values.

But you can't be serving two lords. You need to choose one side. Will it be the Expedition or the Children? You must choose whom you will be supporting over the next few months.
Fine. Your decision, your choice. I hope you understand the consequences.
Pick your side in the upcoming battle

Well, we no longer have a choice - we failed to reach an agreement with the All-Mother, and our time is running out. Felix and Ivan wanted us to occupy the Ambrosia Valley which sprawls northward of the base. The Ambrosia can be harvested there in large amounts. But it looks like these Children are going to stop us.

The chances of winning are nearly equal - they have all the forces of their home world on their side, and we have the power of technomagic and the Ambrosia.

I know that many sympathize with the natives, but for now I need to understand which side you are on.
Good. Your decision, your choice. I hope you understand the consequences.
Speak with the All-Mother, and then go see Rhubarb on the frontline in the Ambrosia Valley.

I advise you to leave the Expedition base as soon as possible. You are not welcome here, to put it mildly.

We will disconnect you from the portal network, although I understand that you can return to Sarnaut with the help of the All-Mother and Skulnar.

But there is nothing else for you here at the Gates Base.

We will deal with the Children ourselves, and you can return to the All-Mother and see if she's happy to have a new supporter...
I see the All-Mother was right to trust you. Since you are on our side, now I recognize you as an ally and a friend. So be it. You are one of us.
Go see Felix at the outpost in the Ambrosia Valley.

As you can imagine, you won't be welcome in the All-Mother's Sanctuary now. They will disconnect you from their portal network. And it looks like Eurial and Skulnar decided to stay in the goddess's domain.

I think they will help the Children, but Felix is a skilled enough commander - he can find a solution to this problem.

Our task is to get as much Ambrosia as possible. With its help, we will gain divine power, and we'll be able to deal with Nihaz ourselves.

Felix will tell you the rest. He has a plan for a military campaign.
I am glad that all doubts have been cast aside and we are working together now. Let's give these logs a beating, shall we? Get ready to hear what I came up with.

You've made your choice! You should talk to All-Mother and inform her of your decision.

I hope you won't forget the world you have come from. Sarnaut is counting on you. Even if you are helping strangers, use it to our mutual advantage.

Fine. I knew you'd come back. You've learned a few lessons but you have many yet to learn. You have seen the face of the Darkness. You know what threatens all of us. I hope you can help my Children. They're very sad.
Eliminate the enemies in the Ambrosia Valley and destroy one Harvester.

The main fighting force of this Expedition is numerous Mechanoids, parodies that imitate life.

We will not tolerate their existence in our world. There is no place for machines here, so the order I give you is simple: destroy as many iron puppets possible. At the same time, try to eliminate one of the Harvesters, they are the most dangerous for our forest.
We forced the enemy to retreat. But only for a while. They will return tomorrow.
Capture two Sources in the valley. Southern, Western, or Eastern Source will do.

The Power of the All-Mother spreads throughout our world. Here, in the Ambrosia Valley, it flows freely through the special Sources. I heard you have something similar in your world, in the places you call the Holy Land, Ammer, and the Kingdom of Elements. If you already know this, then you understand that the Source can be controlled.

The expedition has already figured out how to do this, and we must stop them from gaining the powers that could make them gods.

You need to capture any two Sources. The Northern Source is easy for us to control, so our goal will be the Southern, Western, or Eastern.
We need the power of the Sources. By controlling them, we weaken our enemy.
The Great Tree gave us life. Now it's our turn to protect it.

You are eager to go into battle, but can we trust you, Child of Sarn? First learn the lessons of the All-Mother and decide which side you are on.

But if you want, I'll tell you about our war. Perhaps this will influence your choice.

Are you listening carefully?

When the Expedition arrived at Eden, we began to change. The Children who were once hunters have become warriors, our animals have grown powerful fangs, and our flowers have sprouted thorns.

Other tribes are still peaceful. Living far from the Valley, they do not know troubles and sorrows. They did not deal with the deadly machines and the reanimated bodies of the Old Tribe.

So enlisting their help is not enough. You need to train them.

Unthinkable! Without the All-Mother our worlds will be swallowed by darkness! We need to find a way to tell the other gods what happened...

As for the war with the Expedition... What happened doesn't change anything!

On the contrary, our task has become even more important. To gather strength to fight this… Hirkalla, we need to protect Eden! And even if I stay here alone, I will continue to defend it!

I hope you're still on our side.
Eliminate enemies in the Ambrosia Vale and defeat one Treebor.

The valley is infested with these mossy creatures. They emerge from their burrows in the calm between battles.

Regular clean-up is required to keep this horde from storming our outpost.

Deal with them, and with this huge Treebor that's hanging around the other side of the valley. A creature of such strength is capable of destroying even a Harvester.
One day I'll bring a huge flamethrower here, and it will all be over.
Capture two Sources in the valley. Northern, Western, or Eastern will do.

The Power of the All-Mother spreads throughout this world, from the All-Tree to the very poles. Here, in the Ambrosia Valley, it flows freely through the special Sources. There is a similar thing in our world, I think you know this. You will find similar objects in the Holy Land, Ammr and the Elemental Realm. And you understand that the Source can be controlled. Divine power is exactly what we need.

The Children know we have figured out how to use them and will try to stop us, and we must gain the power that will make us as mighty as the gods.

You need to capture any two Sources. The south source is easy for us to control, so our goal will be the Northern, Western or Eastern.
We need the power of the Sources. By controlling them, we weaken our enemy.
Kill 50 heroes of the Expedition in the Ambrosia Valley.

These heroes of the Expedition are true savages. Maybe they are not even people made of flesh and blood, but some kind of machines. The only thing that drives them is greed.

However, they are nevertheless stubborn and numerous. But we will face them day after day, week after week. The more enemies die at your hands in the valley, the better our chances to save Eden.
The regenerating power of ambrosia works not only for us, but also for our enemies. But healing takes time. Each destroyed enemy gives us time to gather strength.
Kill 50 heroes of the Children in the Ambrosia Valley.

These Children are real savages. They are monsters who must be destroyed! And those who went over to their side are even worse. Traitors oppose us in the Valley.

Those who care more about the local animals than their own world. Those that don't give a damn about the fate of Sarnaut.

They should regret their choice, .

This will be a lesson to the traitors.

And those who faint-heartedly hesitate will now think hard and make the right choice.

Good job, soldier!
Return to the Skulnar and Eurial and tell them everything

Your friends are worried about you.

Skulnar asked you to find them as soon as possible. If you have time, it shouldn't be too much of a bother for you to look in on the All-Mother.

That's how it is. So we'll stay here for now.

And I advise you to think carefully about this, heh.

That's right. The Children or the Expedition.

On the one hand, representatives of our home world who came here for the Ambrosia. A power that has the potential to make us gods.

And then there are the Children, the inhabitants of this world who shouldn't have to suffer because we need this resource. And a powerful goddess who seems to be able to help us.

The choice is not easy.

What do I do? I know better than anyone in Sarnaut what it's like to follow the path that Nihaz mapped out for you. And you know, I don't think that's right at all.

It's great to be powerful - but at what cost? Elleken committed unthinkable atrocities for his own purposes. Tep doomed his people. Ath-Zak was a hero who rejected the temptations of Nihaz. So what do I want to be? A hero or a villain?
h: We'll have to pick a side.

t:
Yes, I noticed that you are learning the lessons of the All-Mother. And Skulnar is also leaning towards the Children. But what should I do? You see, my father would of course have chosen to side with the Expedition, but right now I'm not so sure that I want to be on the same side.

I know better than anyone in Sarnaut what it's like to follow the path that Nihaz mapped out for you. And you know, I don't think that's right at all.

It's great to be powerful - but at what cost? Elleken committed unthinkable atrocities for his own purposes. Tep doomed his people. Ath-Zak was a hero who rejected the temptations of Nihaz. So what do I want to be? A hero or a villain?

Yes, I saw you running errands for them. But it looks like Skulnar is leaning towards the Children. But what should I do? You see, my father would of course have chosen to side with the Expedition, but right now I'm not so sure that I want to be on the same side.

I know better than anyone in Sarnaut what it's like to follow the path that Nihaz mapped out for you. And you know, I don't think that's right at all.

It's great to be powerful - but at what cost? Elleken committed unthinkable atrocities for his own purposes. Tep doomed his people. Ath-Zak was a hero who rejected the temptations of Nihaz. So what do I want to be? A hero or a villain?
Talk to anyone who can give good advice.

So, young manlady. You're having doubts? Don't know what to do?

Well, I think you might as well ask someone for advice... those who remain in Sarnaut. I think each of them has something to say, even if they are not here in Eden and didn't see what we saw.

But... why not ask them anyway?

I myself sometimes doubt whether we are doing the right thing.
Well, did you manage to talk to everyone?

Hah, what a mess.

I'm afraid we have no choice. Whether we wanted it or not, the war has begun!
Talk to anyone who can give good advice.

So, young manlady. You're having doubts? Don't know what to do?

Well, I think you might as well ask someone for advice... those who remain in Sarnaut. I think each of them has something to say, even if they are not here in Eden and didn't see what we saw.

But... why not ask them anyway?

I myself sometimes doubt whether we are doing the right thing.
Well, did you manage to talk to everyone?

Hah, what a mess.

I'm afraid we have no choice. Whether we wanted it or not, the war has begun!

Something strange is happening on in the battlefield...

Dark powers interfere with the battles. Nothing is the way it should be. And you know what? This is amazing!

Go out there and see for yourself!
So, how is our champion doing?

You smell like darkness and blood! You had some fine battles, huh!

Here's your reward!

Oh! What a misfortune! Something crazy is going on in the battlefields.

Dark powers interfere with the battles. Nothing is the way it used to be. And you know what? This is legendary!

Go out there and see it yourself, buddy!
So, how is our champion doing?

You smell like darkness and blood! You had some fine battles!

Here is your reward, friend.

This is an excellent opportunity to earn glory, honors, and respect, and to acquire unique equipment and other valuable items. There are two teams fighting in a Skirmish. The idea is to find out who's the best, who's the strongest. There are no friends or allies. An Imperial team may face another Imperial team, League may fight League.

There are several arenas, each giving you the Signs of Victory. Use these signs to obtain Battleground Emblems and trade them for various prizes!
Do you want to confront other heroes in a fair combat? Welcome to the Battleground!

While we were chasing Catherina, you received a letter. Who sent it?

Our main Historian, Zayan. You've been bringing him all sort of things...

He must have found something. So you should go see him.

Go to Avilon. You've been there before, so you know the way.
Zayan is waiting for you there. Don't make him wait, he might die before you get there.
You received my letter after all? Very well!

As Sarbaz Baybut said, the Sanitation Zone is swarming with Mechanoids. They seem to attack any living being that they see. We could hardly make it to the barricades. Their defenders must have fought to the last.

You know, these barricades are giving me a lot of questions. They were clearly hastily improvised, and we still don't know, what the Imperial scientists were hiding from.
Obtain Matter of Creation and take part in the Sculptor’s experiment.

I’m experimenting with Matter of Creation, trying to go beyond the limits.

In addition to the five crystals I’ve already created, I can try working on another one, but for that, I’ll need an interesting component... known in Sarnaut as “gold”.

If my calculations are correct, the construction of the Stronghold will be completed sooner.
I never understood why you think this material is so valuable. It’s chemically inert. Soft. Heavy. Perhaps it’s some property of the surface? The one you call “gleam”?

Wonderful, synthesis will begin immediately.
 You shouldn’t feel negative emotions about the waste of this resource. Don’t you want to escape the imminent Darkness?
